integrity: General proof is self-contained. Independent direct factor-occurrence enumeration checks a finite grid; finite computation is not substituted for mathematical proof.
scientific_limitations: Only finite words formed from repetitions of a permutation with an optional proper prefix are addressed; arbitrary periodic words with repeated period symbols and nonminimum attractors are excluded. The binary complete-period subcase was previously known. Prior equivalently formulated classifications outside examined literature remain possible.
title: All smallest string attractors of repeated-permutation prefixes
